response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional technical depth with 16+ years of software development and proven ability to share knowledge through workshops and open source, he lacks critical management experience. The resume shows no evidence of people management, direct reports, performance feedback, or team leadership—core minimum requirements for a Level II Manager role. This is a staff engineer with strong individual contribution skills rather than a manager equipped to set team priorities, conduct 1-on-1s, and develop other engineers.
strengths: Exceptional technical breadth across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure with deep understanding of testing, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship practices.
Proven ability to teach and share knowledge through workshops, conference talks, and open source projects demonstrating communication skills and mentoring ability.
Some experience with developer tools including MCP frameworks, test frameworks (Fluent-Asserts, Trial), and CI/CD infrastructure, showing awareness of engineering productivity challenges.
concerns: Complete absence of people management experience—no direct reports, performance management, or team development roles in career history despite 16+ years in industry.
No demonstrated technical leadership experience (tech lead, engineering lead, or architect roles) required to lead and validate system designs for a team.
Experience is broader across full-stack development rather than focused depth in developer tools, compilers, build systems, or testing infrastructure at scale.

key_factors.factor: Strong technical expertise and teaching ability
